tokens.name: primary
tokens.usage: The one saturated color. Primary CTAs (Sign up, Continue, Get started), the active-tab indicator and the wordmark only. At most one red CTA per fold. White text on it is 4.8:1.

tokens.name: primary-pressed
tokens.usage: Pressed state of the primary button: one notch deeper than primary.

tokens.name: on-primary
tokens.usage: Text and icons on primary.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Headlines, button labels, primary nav links, filter-chip-active fill.

tokens.name: ink-soft
tokens.usage: Inline anchor links in body prose only. Not a chrome color.

tokens.name: body
tokens.usage: Default paragraph text on canvas (12.6:1).

tokens.name: charcoal
tokens.usage: Slightly softer body where pure ink is too heavy.

tokens.name: mute
tokens.usage: Metadata, footer links, secondary captions (6.2:1 on canvas).

tokens.name: ash
tokens.usage: Placeholder text, disabled labels, the 1px text-input border. 3.2:1 on canvas: never for text people must read.

tokens.name: stone
tokens.usage: Least-emphasis utility marks and disabled borders. Decorative only.

tokens.name: canvas
tokens.usage: True white base: primary nav, modals, feature cards, page body.

tokens.name: surface-soft
tokens.usage: Faint cream wash behind the home hero.

tokens.name: surface-card
tokens.usage: Warm-cream fill for pin cards, category tiles, search bar, filter chips, icon buttons, disabled buttons.

tokens.name: surface-elevated
tokens.usage: Surfaces lifted over the scrim (modal card).

tokens.name: secondary-bg
tokens.usage: Secondary button fill: one notch deeper than surface-card.

tokens.name: secondary-pressed
tokens.usage: Pressed state of the secondary button.

tokens.name: surface-dark
tokens.usage: Warm near-black for the rare dark CTA strip.

tokens.name: on-dark
tokens.usage: Text on surface-dark and on ink (active chip).

tokens.name: on-dark-mute
tokens.usage: Secondary text on surface-dark (about 9:1).

tokens.name: on-secondary
tokens.usage: Label on secondary-bg.

tokens.name: hairline
tokens.usage: 1px dividers: footer top rule, inner-page nav bottom rule, list rows.

tokens.name: hairline-soft
tokens.usage: Lighter inline divider.

tokens.name: scrim
tokens.usage: The 50% overlay behind modal cards.

tokens.name: focus-outer
tokens.usage: Outer ring of the focus stack on every focusable element.

tokens.name: focus-inner
tokens.usage: White gap inside the focus ring.

tokens.name: error
tokens.usage: Validation messages and destructive copy (8.6:1 on canvas).

tokens.name: error-deep
tokens.usage: Deeper error fill where error needs more weight. Same value as primary-pressed, different meaning.

tokens.name: success-deep
tokens.usage: Success message text; on success-pale it reads 10:1.

tokens.name: success-pale
tokens.usage: Background of a success pill.

tokens.name: accent-pressed-blue
tokens.usage: Pressed state of blue informational badges. Editorial only.

tokens.name: accent-purple
tokens.usage: Editorial recommendation badge. Inside content, never chrome.

tokens.name: accent-purple-deep
tokens.usage: Paired dark for purple lockups.

families.sans: Inter, -apple-system, system-ui, "Segoe UI", Roboto, "Helvetica Neue", Arial, sans-serif

styles.name: display-xl
styles.usage: Top-of-page hero headline only. Scales 56 / 44 / 36px down the breakpoints.

styles.name: display-lg
styles.usage: Secondary hero on creator and business pages.

styles.name: heading-xl
styles.sample: Bring your favorite ideas to life
styles.usage: Section headings, feature-card headlines, dark CTA strip.

styles.name: body-md
styles.sample: Find recipes, home ideas and style inspiration.

styles.name: body-strong
styles.usage: Inline emphasis, primary nav links, form labels.

styles.name: body-sm
styles.usage: Footer copy, pin metadata, helper text.

styles.name: body-sm-strong
styles.usage: Result counts, footer column headers, avatar names.

styles.name: link-md
styles.usage: Inline anchor in body prose, colored ink-soft.

styles.name: caption-sm
styles.usage: Copyright and the smallest utility text.

styles.name: button-md
styles.usage: Primary and secondary button labels, filter chips.

styles.name: button-sm
styles.usage: Overlay pills and compact in-card buttons.

spacing.note: 8px base with finer 4 / 6px steps for tight inline gaps.

tokens.name: space-xxs
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gap inside pills.

tokens.name: space-xs
tokens.usage: Vertical padding in buttons; mobile pin-grid gutter.

tokens.name: space-sm
tokens.usage: Pin-grid gutter (both axes): images nearly touch.

tokens.name: space-md
tokens.usage: Gap between chips; overlay inset from a pin edge.

tokens.name: space-lg
tokens.usage: Category-tile padding; form-field gap.

tokens.name: space-xl
tokens.usage: Page side gutter at desktop; footer horizontal padding.

tokens.name: space-xxl
tokens.usage: Modal and feature-card padding; mobile section gap.

tokens.name: space-section
tokens.usage: Vertical rhythm between major sections (48px tablet, 32px mobile).

radius.note: Three radii in active use: 16px, 32px and pill. Nothing between 16 and 32; no square interactive elements.

tokens.name: radius-none
tokens.usage: Structural bands only: nav, footer, page sections, dark CTA strip.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Rare: an editorial tooltip.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, pin cards, feature cards, category tiles: the default.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Large feature pins and modal cards.

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: Search bar, filter chips, overlay pills, icon buttons, avatars.

shadow.note: Content surfaces are flat. The only shadow sits under the modal card.

tokens.name: shadow-modal
tokens.usage: Ambient 16px shadow under modal-card, over the scrim.

tokens.name: size-button
tokens.usage: Primary and secondary button height.

tokens.name: size-icon-button
tokens.usage: Circular icon button (hit area padded to 48px).

tokens.name: size-input
tokens.usage: Text input height.

tokens.name: size-search
tokens.usage: Search bar height.

tokens.name: size-nav
tokens.usage: Primary nav height.

tokens.name: size-content
tokens.usage: Max content width at desktop.
